prompt: Int() and Uint() return wrapped-around garbage for values outside the 64-bit range, both for JSON numbers (18446744073709551616, 9223372036854775808, -9223372036854775809.1) and for numeric strings ("18446744073709551616", "18446744073709551616.1"). Out-of-range values must clamp to the type's minimum or maximum, fractional parts are dropped, and negative values give 0 from Uint(). Fix it.
